finding_key: packages/docs/src/export/docx-style-map.ts::`toheadingstyleid` sanitization of `headinglevel` into `<w:pstyle w:val>` has no test
evidence: The full packages/docs/test/export/docx-style-map.test.ts at this commit is supplied and contains no test touching headingLevel/pStyle/toHeadingStyleId; every buildParagraphPropertiesXml call omits the headingLevel argument. The diff's new toHeadingStyleId (docx-style-map.ts) — an injection/schema guard analogous to the tested DOCX_ALIGNMENTS and toDocxHexColor guards — therefore has no coverage of its accept or reject paths, and reverting it to raw interpolation would leave the suite green. Minor caveat: pre-existing docx-exporter.test.ts is not fully visible, but any legacy valid-level test there would not exercise the sanitizer's rejection behavior anyway.
